Maria Lopez: Quick note 10am PT publish tomorrow for DevTool deep-dive. Need owned-channel plan: hero tweet, LinkedIn, changelog, community post, ES/FR translations, sales one-pager, influencer outreach. Who can take what?
Samir Patel: I can do tweets + LinkedIn. Need final headline + URL.
Evan Chen: I'll write the changelog and sales one-pager. Need final numbers by 8am PT.
Courtney Blake: I'll handle ES/FR translations, deliver by 9am PT. No JP for this launch.
Jena (publish-bot): Scheduled publish job: 2026-06-16 17:00:00 UTC. Draft URL: https://blog.redwood.inference/devtool-release (placeholder).
Samir Patel: Draft tweets (w/UTMs):
- Short: Ship faster with Redwood DevTool 1z up to 30% lower inference latency. Blog + benchmarks: https://blog.redwood.inference/devtool-release?utm_source=twitter&utm_campaign=devtool_launch&utm_medium=tweet
- Card: Ship faster. Run models cheaper. DevTool cuts inference latency by up to 30% and boosts throughput. Read more: [link]
Evan Chen: Engineering numbers: up to 30% latency decrease (batch/seq dependent), ~1.4x throughput in lab tests. Use "up to" language and link benchmarks.
Maria Lopez: Design: small "up to 30%" stat badge on hero ok?
Samir Patel: Confirmed. Design will send assets by 6am PT.
Maria Lopez: Product + Legal need sign-off by 7:30am PT. Evan, can you chase approvals?
Evan Chen: On it 1 pinging Product & Legal now.
Samir Patel: I'll prep #announcements copy and influencer outreach template for send at publish time.
Maria Lopez: Brilliant. Drop any blockers here. :sparkles:
